reasons: CS4236 prerequisite includes CS2030S, but the student requires finishing CS4236 before starting CS2030S, creating a circular dependency.

CS4222 requires CS2105 or equivalent, which requires CS2040/CS2040S etc., which require CS1010. CS1010 is not completed and must be taken in Y1S1 or Y1S2. CS4222 cannot be taken in Y1S1 as prerequisites are not met.
